detailZh: 新加坡大奖赛：维斯塔潘首次在F1职业生涯中赢得比赛，领先查尔斯·勒克莱尔夺冠，勒克莱尔表示对策略失误道歉。
红牛车队的维斯塔潘在新加坡大奖赛中以灯灭到旗落的全场胜利统治了比赛；查尔斯·勒克莱尔获得第二名，基米·安东内利获得第三名；汉密尔顿因策略失误，最终跌出领奖台。
维斯塔潘首次赢得新加坡大奖赛
维斯塔潘在F1职业生涯中首次以一场统治性的胜利赢得新加坡大奖赛，而法拉利的勒克莱尔则因策略失误，在比赛后期跌出领奖台。
维斯塔潘尽管因为无线电问题无法与车队沟通，但他在比赛中领跑每一圈，连续第二次获胜，尽管法拉利的查尔斯·勒克莱尔在早期发起了挑战，最终以七秒之差排在第二。
基米·安东内利利用了汉密尔顿和迈凯轮的兰多·诺里斯在后期展开的激烈对抗的机会，在后者后期的轮胎磨损严重的情况下，获得了第三名，并在车手积分榜上以102分的优势领先乔治·拉塞尔。

detailEn: Singapore GP: Max Verstappen wins event for first time in F1 career ahead of Charles Leclerc as Lewis Hamilton apologises for strategy

Red Bull's Max Verstappen dominated the Singapore Grand Prix with a lights-to-flag victory; Charles Leclerc was second and Kimi Antonelli third; Lewis Hamilton apologised for a messy race strategically that saw him finish down in sixth
Max Verstappen wins the Singapore Grand Prix for the first time

Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix for the first time in his Formula 1 career with a dominant victory, while Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton endured a messy strategic race to tumble off the podium late on.

Verstappen led every lap on his way to a second consecutive win despite being unable to communicate with the team due to a radio problem, but it did not affect him as he held off an early challenge from Ferrari's Charles Leclerc who eventually finished seven seconds behind in second.

Kimi Antonelli took advantage of an elbows-out battle late on between Hamilton and McLaren's Lando Norris, with the seven-time world champion on old tyres in the latter stages, to take third and extend his lead over George Russell to 102 points in the Drivers' Championship.

Russell recovered to ninth in Sunday's race after starting 19th due to grid penalties for a new power unit, as overtaking proved very difficult at the Marina Bay Street Circuit.
Reigning world champion Norris was fourth ahead of McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri, who also overtook an ailing Hamilton late on.

Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson had another strong result in seventh with Audi's Nico Hulkenberg in eighth, while Red Bull's Isack Hadjar went from the pit lane to the points in 10th.

detailEn: United States GP: Lewis Hamilton fastest from Max Verstappen in final practice ahead of Qualifying in Austin

Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton outpaced Red Bull's Max Verstappen in final practice in Austin with Friday's pace-setter Charles Leclerc in third; watch every United States GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 10pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
Lewis Hamilton claims the fastest lap from Max Verstappen in final practice at the United States Grand Prix
Lewis Hamilton topped final practice from Max Verstappen at the United States Grand Prix to set up a tantalising qualifying in Austin.
Hamilton was 0.168s quicker than Verstappen as Ferrari and Red Bull look set to fight for pole position and victory for a second consecutive weekend.
Charles Leclerc topped both of Friday's sessions and had set the quickest time in final practice by one tenth from Hamilton, only for it to be deleted due to track limits.

Track limits is set to be a major issue for the drivers in qualifying, which takes place at 10pm UK time later on Saturday (build-up from 8.30pm live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event) due to the tarmac run-off areas and the drivers keen to use every bit of track to gain lap time.

Leclerc still finished the session in third, ahead of championship leader Kimi Antonelli whose chances of becoming the youngest world champion look extremely difficult, given he must first win the Grand Prix to give himself an opportunity, and Mercedes are a tad off the pace.
Antonelli was three tenths behind Hamilton's pace-setting time with his Mercedes team-mate George Russell in fifth at nearly half a second down.

McLaren's Lando Norris was eighth but would have been in the top five had his best lap not been deleted for track limit, while Oscar Piastri was sixth and Audi's Nico Hulkenberg impressing in seventh.
